headline: UK Chancellor Healey Unveils Energy Relief and Bank Tax in Budget
summary: UK Chancellor John Healey announced a 100-pound energy bill measure and a bank tax in his Autumn Budget. The Office for Budget Responsibility warned that higher energy prices will impact living standards and economic growth.
why: The UK budget outlines tax policies and public spending plans for Europe's second-largest economy, directly influencing fiscal deficits and business taxation.

impacts.name: UK Banking Sector
impacts.why: A new bank tax increases tax burdens and directly lowers net earnings for financial institutions.
